units.source_text: 源氏中将所表演的舞蹈是双人舞《青海波》，对手是左大臣家公子头中将。

en.t: The dance performed by Genji, the Middle Captain, was the two-person dance
, and his partner was To no Chujo, the son of the Minister of the Left.

units.source_text: 这位头中将的丰姿与品格均甚优雅，迥异凡人；

en.t: This To no Chujo was exceedingly graceful in both appearance and character, quite unlike ordinary men;

units.source_text: 但和源氏中将并立起来，好比樱花树旁边的一株山木，显然逊色了。

en.t: but when he stood beside Genji, he was like a wild mountain tree next to a cherry blossom, and was plainly outshone.
